groups.name: spring.setting.redis
groups.description: Configuration properties for Spring Setting Redis module using reactive Redis operations.

properties.name: spring.setting.redis.prefix
properties.description: Prefix for all setting keys stored in Redis. Defaults to 'setting:'.

properties.name: spring.setting.redis.ttl
properties.description: Time-to-live duration for Redis keys. Defaults to 5 minutes.

values.description: 1 minute - short TTL for frequently changing data
1 hour - longer TTL for stable data
24 hours - long TTL for rarely changing data
